verdict.rationale: Supabase documents version-controlled migration files built from a local CLI stack. It also documents branching, which creates isolated preview environments per pull request so you can test schema changes without affecting production. Community comments call the migration story a weakness, but they are general complaints, not a concrete failure of branching. Missing for 10: evidence of a merge/promote-to-production step, any online or non-locking DDL safeguards against table locks during deploys, and independent hands-on corroboration that branching works.
